description: Core library of the VisioForge .NET SDKs: Video Capture SDK .NET, Media Player SDK .NET, Video Edit SDK .NET and Media Blocks SDK .NET. Video and audio capture, screen recording, playback, editing, streaming and processing for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS. The cross-platform engines are built on GStreamer; the Windows-only engines on DirectShow. Targets .NET Framework 4.6.1+, .NET Core 3.1 and .NET 5 to .NET 11. Samples - https://github.com/visioforge/.Net-SDK-s-samples .
releaseNotes: Bug fixes and performance improvements. Please check the changelog.
